attempts.summary: Used Ansible (run from node2, which has ansible-playbook installed and served as the control node against node1) to harden node1's /tmp and /dev/shm mounts with noexec, nosuid, nodev, persisted via /etc/fstab. Verified execution, setuid, and device-node access are all blocked on both mounts, confirmed idempotency, and completed the mandatory single-node-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol for both node1 and node2, proving boot-identity change and post-restart health for each.
